Thanks for flagging —

Legal (Kim) and I reviewed. Quick decisions:
- SOC2: We can share a redacted SOC2 excerpt and a one-page controls summary. Kimberly, please attach the redacted doc (SOC2-excerpt.pdf).
- Termination clause: Accept the 60-day termination for the pilot with an explicit note that billing is pro-rated to the day and equipment access sunset follows the 60-day clock. Keep the rest of the SOW unchanged.
- Ops (Jasmine): hold a soft reservation for the 02/07 onboarding slot. If sign-by becomes later than 01/31 we will deprioritize and offer the next window (02/21) as an alternative.

Kimberly / Jasmine: can you finalize that language and send a sign-ready SOW + DocuSign wrapper to Soojin by COB 01/19? Soojin — I'll authorize a standard 5% onboarding credit if Novus signs by 01/28; if they sign after but by 01/31 we keep the published pricing.

-Marcus
